description: Night photograph of the Tribute in Light memorial: two vertical beams of blue-white light rising from Lower Manhattan into the night sky, commemorating the September 11 attacks and the fallen Twin Towers. Lit skyscrapers of the Manhattan skyline and dark water in the foreground. Filename '9-11.jpg' matches the subject.
